mission_09: Excellent! You have successfully applied Mutual Information for feature selection and compared it with the F-test. You learned how MI captures non-linear relationships that linear tests miss, making it a more comprehensive feature selection method. The comparison showed that MI identified the engineered non-linear features (squared and sine transformations) as highly informative, while the F-test ranked them lower. Use MI when you suspect non-linear relationships in your data, and combine it with other selection methods for a robust feature selection strategy. MI is computationally more expensive but often discovers valuable features that linear methods overlook.
